P4 Guard Model
```{r}
# --- 0. Load Libraries ---
library(dplyr)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(ggplot2)
library(pROC)
library(car)
library(tidyr)

ol_full_fbs <- ol_full_fbs %>%
  mutate(across(contains("Percentage"), ~ {
    val <- as.numeric(gsub("%", "", .))
    val <- ifelse(is.na(val), 0, val)
    ifelse(val > 1, val / 100, val)
  }))

names(ol_full_fbs)[sapply(ol_full_fbs, is.numeric)]


# --- 1. Prep OL Data (filter to P4 only) ---
ol_data <- ol_full_fbs %>%
  filter(Conference_Level == "P4", Position == "G") %>%
  separate(Penalties, into = c("Penalties.Committed", "Penalties.Declined"), sep = "-", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Penalties.Committed = as.numeric(Penalties.Committed),
    Penalties.Declined  = as.numeric(Penalties.Declined),
    SNAPS               = ifelse(is.na(SNAPS), 1, SNAPS),  # Prevent divide-by-zero
    Row_ID              = row_number()
  ) %>%
  rename(Season = Season)

# --- 2. Save Identifiers ---
player_info <- ol_data %>% select(Row_ID, Name, Team, Season, All_Con, Position)

# --- 3. Select Numeric + Keep Desired Features ---
drop_cols <- c("Player.Id", "Name", "Team", "Team.Name", "Conference", "Conference_Level", "Position", 
               "Player.College.GSIS", "Season", "Games.Won", "Penalties", "Jersey.Number", "Left.Tackle",
               "Left.Guard", "Center", "Right.Guard", "Right.Tackle", "Other", "Center.Snaps.in.Shotgun",
               "Runblocks", "Gap.Runblock", "Other.Runblock", "Pass.Blocks", "Screen.Plays", "Key.Plays",
               "Zone.Runblock", "Positive.Plays", "Negative.Plays")

df_numeric <- ol_data %>%
  select(-any_of(drop_cols)) %>%          # drop only what YOU want gone
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .))) %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%           # keep all numeric football features
  mutate(
    All_Con = ol_data$All_Con,
    Row_ID  = ol_data$Row_ID
  )
# --- 4. Remove Zero-Variance Columns ---
df_predictors <- df_numeric %>% select(-All_Con, -Row_ID)
zero_var_cols <- sapply(df_predictors, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0)
df_numeric <- df_predictors[, !zero_var_cols, drop = FALSE]

# --- 5. Drop Corrupted/Bad Correlation Columns ---
cor_matrix <- cor(df_numeric, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
bad_cols <- colnames(cor_matrix)[apply(cor_matrix, 2, function(x) any(is.na(x) | is.nan(x)))]
df_numeric <- df_numeric %>% select(-any_of(bad_cols))

# --- 6. Reattach Labels ---
df_numeric$All_Con <- ol_data$All_Con[1:nrow(df_numeric)]
df_numeric$Row_ID  <- ol_data$Row_ID[1:nrow(df_numeric)]

# --- 7. Remove Highly Correlated Features ---
cor_matrix <- cor(df_numeric %>% select(-All_Con, -Row_ID))
high_cor <- findCorrelation(cor_matrix, cutoff = 0.7)
df_final <- df_numeric %>% select(-all_of(names(cor_matrix)[high_cor]), All_Con, Row_ID)

# --- 8. Remove Multicollinearity (VIF) ---
reduce_vif <- function(df, threshold = 5) {
  y <- df$All_Con
  ids <- df$Row_ID
  X <- df %>% select(-All_Con, -Row_ID)

  qr_decomp <- qr(as.matrix(X))
  independent <- qr_decomp$pivot[1:qr_decomp$rank]
  X_clean <- X[, independent, drop = FALSE]

  df_clean <- cbind(X_clean, All_Con = y, Row_ID = ids)

  repeat {
    model <- tryCatch(
      glm(All_Con ~ ., data = df_clean %>% select(-Row_ID), family = binomial),
      error = function(e) return(NULL)
    )

    if (is.null(model)) break

    vifs <- tryCatch(vif(model), error = function(e) return(rep(NA, ncol(df_clean) - 2)))
    if (all(is.na(vifs))) break

    if (max(vifs, na.rm = TRUE) < threshold) break

    var_to_remove <- names(which.max(vifs))
    df_clean <- df_clean %>% select(-all_of(var_to_remove))
  }

  return(df_clean)
}

df_final_vif <- reduce_vif(df_final)
df_final_vif <- na.omit(df_final_vif)

# --- 9. Train/Test Split ---
set.seed(42)
train_index <- createDataPartition(df_final_vif$All_Con, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data  <- df_final_vif[train_index, ]
test_data   <- df_final_vif[-train_index, ]

# --- 10. Train Random Forest ---
rf_model <- randomForest(as.factor(All_Con) ~ ., 
                         data = train_data %>% select(-Row_ID), 
                         ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)

# --- 11. Predict & Grade ---
pred_test_prob <- predict(rf_model, test_data, type = "prob")
test_data$Composite_Score <- pred_test_prob[, 2]

test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.90) ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.75) ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.50) ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.25) ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 12. Merge Back with Names ---
test_data_named <- test_data %>% left_join(player_info, by = "Row_ID")

# --- 13. Output Top OL Players ---
player_grades <- test_data_named %>%
  select(Name, Team, Position, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

print(head(player_grades, 20))

# --- 14. Visualizations ---
# Grade Distribution
ggplot(test_data, aes(x = Player_Grade)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "forestgreen") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of OL Player Grades", x = "Grade", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# Composite Score Histogram
ggplot(test_data, aes(x = Composite_Score)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, fill = "darkorange", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Composite Score Distribution (OL)", x = "Score", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# ROC Curve & AUC
#roc_obj <- roc(test_data$All_Con, test_data$Composite_Score)
#plot(roc_obj, col = "blue", main = "ROC Curve - OL All_Con")
#cat("AUC:", auc(roc_obj), "\n")

# Feature Importance
importance_df <- data.frame(
  Feature = rownames(importance(rf_model)),
  Importance = importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))

ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = reorder(Feature, Importance), y = Importance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Feature Importance - OL Model", x = "Feature", y = "MeanDecreaseGini") +
  theme_minimal()

# --- 15. Confusion Matrix & Metrics ---
conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(predict(rf_model, test_data), as.factor(test_data$All_Con))

calc_metrics <- function(cm) {
  TP <- cm$table[2, 2]
  TN <- cm$table[1, 1]
  FP <- cm$table[1, 2]
  FN <- cm$table[2, 1]

  accuracy <- cm$overall["Accuracy"]
  precision <- if ((TP + FP) == 0) NA else TP / (TP + FP)
  recall <- if ((TP + FN) == 0) NA else TP / (TP + FN)
  specificity <- if ((TN + FP) == 0) NA else TN / (TN + FP)
  balanced_accuracy <- mean(c(recall, specificity), na.rm = TRUE)
  f1_score <- if ((precision + recall) == 0 || is.na(precision + recall)) NA else 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)

  tibble(
    Accuracy = as.numeric(accuracy),
    Precision = precision,
    Recall = recall,
    Specificity = specificity,
    Balanced_Accuracy = balanced_accuracy,
    F1_Score = f1_score
  )
}

calc_metrics(conf_matrix)

# --- 16. Predict on Full Dataset ---
full_pred_prob <- predict(rf_model, df_final_vif %>% select(-Row_ID, -All_Con), type = "prob")
df_final_vif$Composite_Score <- full_pred_prob[, 2]

full_data_with_info <- df_final_vif %>%
  left_join(player_info, by = "Row_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# 2024 Rankings Only
players_2024 <- full_data_with_info %>%
  filter(Season == 2025) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score)) %>%
  select(Name, Team, Season, Position, Composite_Score, Player_Grade)

View(players_2024)

# Full 2024 Stats
players_2024_stats <- full_data_with_info %>%
  filter(Season == 2025) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score)) %>%
  select(Name, Team, Player_Grade, Composite_Score, everything(), -Row_ID)

View(players_2024_stats)

# --- 18. Feature Importance Output ---
importance_df <- data.frame(
  Feature = rownames(importance(rf_model)),
  Importance = importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))

print(importance_df)
View(importance_df)
```

P4 Week 1
```{r}
# --- P4 Week 1 Guard Grading ---

# Correct way to change underscores to dots
colnames(ol_week1_2024) <- gsub("_", ".", colnames(ol_week1_2024))
colnames(offensive_summary_week1_2024) <- gsub("_", ".", colnames(offensive_summary_week1_2024))

# Verify the changes
colnames(ol_week1_2024)

# First filter for P4 Guards with at least 10 snaps (use Offensive.Snaps column)
p4_og_week1_2024 <- ol_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Conference.Level == "P4", 
         Position == "G", 
         Offensive.Snaps > 30)

cat("Number of Guards after filtering:", nrow(p4_og_week1_2024), "\n")
glimpse(p4_og_week1_2024)

# --- Add Offensive Snaps from Summary (if needed) ---
og_summary_snaps <- offensive_summary_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "G") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive.Snaps)

# Join snaps to Guard data (if needed)
p4_og_week1_2024 <- p4_og_week1_2024 %>%
  left_join(og_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# Handle any duplicate Offensive.Snaps columns
if ("Offensive.Snaps.x" %in% colnames(p4_og_week1_2024)) {
  p4_og_week1_2024 <- p4_og_week1_2024 %>%
    mutate(Offensive.Snaps = coalesce(Offensive.Snaps.x, Offensive.Snaps.y)) %>%
    select(-Offensive.Snaps.x, -Offensive.Snaps.y)
}

# --- Guard Weighted Grading Model ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (P4 Guard Model) ---
# Note: Negative weights for stats where lower numbers are better
feature_weights <- c(
  # Positive weights (higher is better)
  "Runblock.Grade" = 33.537126,
  "Percentage.of.Positive.Grade" = 27.989304,
  "Passblock.Grade" = 25.026261,
  "Defeated.Runblock.Percentage" = 22.413107,
  "Knockdown.Percentage" = 18.139550,
  "Games.Started" = 17.401159,
  "Pass.Block.Efficiency" = 15.300389,
  "Games.Played" = 11.868095,
  
  # Negative weights (lower is better)
  "Pressure.allowed.Percentage" = -20.877615,
  "Hurries.Allowed" = -14.531557,
  "Beaten.by.Defender" = -14.379106,
  "Hits.Allowed" = -10.078866,
  "Penalties.Committed" = -8.928237,
  "Sacks.Allowed" = -7.048949,
  "Recovered.Fumbles" = -4.220199,
  "Penalties.Declined" = -2.765358
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        # For negative weights, lower raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        # For positive weights, higher raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to Guard dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(p4_og_week1_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(p4_og_week1_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
og_input_all <- p4_og_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
og_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(og_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(og_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
```

```{r}
cat("Number of Guards after filtering:", nrow(g5_og_week1_2024), "\n")
glimpse(g5_og_week1_2024)

# --- Add Offensive Snaps from Summary (if needed) ---

# Join snaps to Guard data (if needed)

  left_join(og_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# Handle any duplicate Offensive.Snaps columns
if ("Offensive.Snaps.x" %in% colnames(g5_og_week1_2024)) {
  g5_og_week1_2024 <- g5_og_week1_2024 %>%
    mutate(Offensive.Snaps = coalesce(Offensive.Snaps.x, Offensive.Snaps.y)) %>%
    select(-Offensive.Snaps.x, -Offensive.Snaps.y)
}

# --- Guard Weighted Grading Model ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (G5 Guard Model) ---
# Note: Negative weights for stats where lower numbers are better
feature_weights <- c(
  # Positive weights (higher is better)
  "Runblock.Grade" = 35.700175,
  "Passblock.Grade" = 29.819727,
  "Percentage.of.Positive.Grade" = 29.647398,
  "Knockdown.Percentage" = 26.324587,
  "Games.Played" = 21.093918,
  "Pass.Block.Efficiency" = 13.252965,
  
  # Negative weights (lower is better)
  "Percentage.of.Negative.Grade" = -25.347985,
  "Pressure.allowed.Percentage" = -22.982644,
  "Hurries.Allowed" = -19.517631,
  "Beaten.by.Defender" = -17.454432,
  "Hits.Allowed" = -12.965955,
  "Penalties.Committed" = -9.781874,
  "Sacks.Allowed" = -9.203753,
  "Penalties.Declined" = -4.481739,
  "Recovered.Fumbles" = -4.103120
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        # For negative weights, lower raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        # For positive weights, higher raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to Guard dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(g5_og_week1_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(g5_og_week1_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {

}

  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns

  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
og_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(og_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(og_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2

} else {

}

    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View ---
```

```{r}
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        # For positive weights, higher raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to Guard dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(g5_og_week2_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(g5_og_week2_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
og_input_all <- g5_og_week2_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
og_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(og_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(og_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  og_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View ---
important_features <- names(feature_weights)

og_full_view <- og_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    any_of(important_features)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
og_eval_summary <- og_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== G5 GUARD WEEK 2 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(og_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(og_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 GUARDS ===\n")
print(head(og_eval_summary, 10))

View(og_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats

  og_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 2/G5/G5 Guard Full Stats Week 2.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 2/G5/G5 Guard Week 2 Grade 2024.csv",

cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
```

```{r}
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
```

```{r}
  # Positive weights (higher is better)
  "Runblock.Grade" = 33.537126,
  "Percentage.of.Positive.Grade" = 27.989304,
  "Passblock.Grade" = 25.026261,
  "Defeated.Runblock.Percentage" = 22.413107,
  "Knockdown.Percentage" = 18.139550,
  "Games.Started" = 17.401159,
  "Pass.Block.Efficiency" = 15.300389,
  "Games.Played" = 11.868095,
  
  # Negative weights (lower is better)
  "Pressure.allowed.Percentage" = -20.877615,
  "Hurries.Allowed" = -14.531557,
  "Beaten.by.Defender" = -14.379106,
  "Hits.Allowed" = -10.078866,
  "Penalties.Committed" = -8.928237,
  "Sacks.Allowed" = -7.048949,
  "Recovered.Fumbles" = -4.220199,
  "Penalties.Declined" = -2.765358
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        # For negative weights, lower raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        # For positive weights, higher raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to Guard dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(p4_og_week4_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(p4_og_week4_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
og_input_all <- p4_og_week4_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
og_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(og_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(og_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  og_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View ---
important_features <- names(feature_weights)

og_full_view <- og_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    any_of(important_features)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
og_eval_summary <- og_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== P4 GUARD WEEK 4 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(og_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(og_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 GUARDS ===\n")
print(head(og_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(og_eval_summary)
View(og_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats
write.csv(
  og_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 4/P4/P4 Guard Full Stats Week 4.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet
write.csv(
  og_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 4/P4/P4 Guard Week 4 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. P4 Guard Full Stats Week 4.csv\n")
cat("2. P4 Guard Week 4 Grade 2024.csv\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total Guards evaluated:", nrow(og_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---
grade_dist <- og_eval_summary %>%
  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(og_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
# --- G5 Week 5 Guard Grading ---

# Correct way to change underscores to dots
colnames(ol_week5_2024) <- gsub("_", ".", colnames(ol_week5_2024))
colnames(offensive_summary_week5_2024) <- gsub("_", ".", colnames(offensive_summary_week5_2024))

# Verify the changes
colnames(ol_week5_2024)

# First filter for G5 Guards with at least 30 snaps (use Offensive.Snaps column)
# Also remove NOTRE DAME, UMASS, UCONN, ARMY, NAVY, AIR FORCE
g5_og_week5_2024 <- ol_week5_2024 %>%
  filter(Conference.Level == "G5", 
         Position == "G", 
         Offensive.Snaps > 30,
         !Team %in% c("NOTRE DAME", "UMASS", "UCONN", "ARMY", "NAVY", "AIR FORCE"))

cat("Number of Guards after filtering:", nrow(g5_og_week5_2024), "\n")
glimpse(g5_og_week5_2024)

# --- Add Offensive Snaps from Summary (if needed) ---
og_summary_snaps <- offensive_summary_week5_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "G") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive.Snaps)

# Join snaps to Guard data (if needed)
g5_og_week5_2024 <- g5_og_week5_2024 %>%
  left_join(og_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# Handle any duplicate Offensive.Snaps columns
if ("Offensive.Snaps.x" %in% colnames(g5_og_week5_2024)) {
  g5_og_week5_2024 <- g5_og_week5_2024 %>%
    mutate(Offensive.Snaps = coalesce(Offensive.Snaps.x, Offensive.Snaps.y)) %>%
    select(-Offensive.Snaps.x, -Offensive.Snaps.y)
}

# --- Guard Weighted Grading Model ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (G5 Guard Model) ---
# Note: Negative weights for stats where lower numbers are better
feature_weights <- c(
  # Positive weights (higher is better)
  "Runblock.Grade" = 35.700175,
  "Passblock.Grade" = 29.819727,
  "Percentage.of.Positive.Grade" = 29.647398,
  "Knockdown.Percentage" = 26.324587,
  "Games.Played" = 21.093918,
  "Pass.Block.Efficiency" = 13.252965,
  
  # Negative weights (lower is better)
  "Percentage.of.Negative.Grade" = -25.347985,
  "Pressure.allowed.Percentage" = -22.982644,
  "Hurries.Allowed" = -19.517631,
  "Beaten.by.Defender" = -17.454432,
  "Hits.Allowed" = -12.965955,
  "Penalties.Committed" = -9.781874,
  "Sacks.Allowed" = -9.203753,
  "Penalties.Declined" = -4.481739,
  "Recovered.Fumbles" = -4.103120
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        # For negative weights, lower raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        # For positive weights, higher raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to Guard dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(g5_og_week5_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(g5_og_week5_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
og_input_all <- g5_og_week5_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
og_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(og_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(og_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  og_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View ---
important_features <- names(feature_weights)

og_full_view <- og_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    any_of(important_features)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
og_eval_summary <- og_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== G5 GUARD WEEK 5 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(og_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(og_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 GUARDS ===\n")
print(head(og_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(og_eval_summary)
View(og_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats
write.csv(
  og_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 5/G5/G5 Guard Full Stats Week 5.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet
write.csv(
  og_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 5/G5/G5 Guard Week 5 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. G5 Guard Full Stats Week 5.csv\n")
cat("2. G5 Guard Week 5 Grade 2024.csv\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---

cat("Total Guards evaluated:", nrow(og_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---

  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(og_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
colnames(offensive_summary_week7_2024) <- gsub("_", ".", colnames(offensive_summary_week7_2024))

# Verify the changes
colnames(ol_week7_2024)

# First filter for P4 Guards with at least 30 snaps (use Offensive.Snaps column)
p4_og_week7_2024 <- ol_week7_2024 %>%
  filter(Conference.Level == "P4", 
         Position == "G", 
         Offensive.Snaps > 30)

cat("Number of Guards after filtering:", nrow(p4_og_week7_2024), "\n")
glimpse(p4_og_week7_2024)

# --- Add Offensive Snaps from Summary (if needed) ---
og_summary_snaps <- offensive_summary_week7_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "G") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive.Snaps)

# Join snaps to Guard data (if needed)
p4_og_week7_2024 <- p4_og_week7_2024 %>%
  left_join(og_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# Handle any duplicate Offensive.Snaps columns
if ("Offensive.Snaps.x" %in% colnames(p4_og_week7_2024)) {
  p4_og_week7_2024 <- p4_og_week7_2024 %>%
    mutate(Offensive.Snaps = coalesce(Offensive.Snaps.x, Offensive.Snaps.y)) %>%
    select(-Offensive.Snaps.x, -Offensive.Snaps.y)
}

# --- Guard Weighted Grading Model ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (P4 Guard Model) ---
# Note: Negative weights for stats where lower numbers are better
feature_weights <- c(
  # Positive weights (higher is better)
  "Runblock.Grade" = 33.537126,
  "Percentage.of.Positive.Grade" = 27.989304,
  "Passblock.Grade" = 25.026261,
  "Defeated.Runblock.Percentage" = 22.413107,
  "Knockdown.Percentage" = 18.139550,
  "Games.Started" = 17.401159,
  "Pass.Block.Efficiency" = 15.300389,
  "Games.Played" = 11.868095,
  
  # Negative weights (lower is better)
  "Pressure.allowed.Percentage" = -20.877615,
  "Hurries.Allowed" = -14.531557,
  "Beaten.by.Defender" = -14.379106,
  "Hits.Allowed" = -10.078866,
  "Penalties.Committed" = -8.928237,
  "Sacks.Allowed" = -7.048949,
  "Recovered.Fumbles" = -4.220199,
  "Penalties.Declined" = -2.765358
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        # For negative weights, lower raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        # For positive weights, higher raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to Guard dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(p4_og_week7_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(p4_og_week7_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
og_input_all <- p4_og_week7_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
og_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(og_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(og_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  og_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View ---
important_features <- names(feature_weights)

og_full_view <- og_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,

  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---

  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))
```

```{r}
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
og_input_all <- p4_og_week8_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
og_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(og_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(og_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  og_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View ---
important_features <- names(feature_weights)

og_full_view <- og_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    any_of(important_features)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
```

```{r}
# --- Guard Weighted Grading Model ---

  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (G5 Guard Model) ---
# Note: Negative weights for stats where lower numbers are better
feature_weights <- c(
  # Positive weights (higher is better)
  "Runblock.Grade" = 35.700175,
  "Passblock.Grade" = 29.819727,
  "Percentage.of.Positive.Grade" = 29.647398,
  "Knockdown.Percentage" = 26.324587,
  "Games.Played" = 21.093918,
  "Pass.Block.Efficiency" = 13.252965,
  
  # Negative weights (lower is better)
  "Percentage.of.Negative.Grade" = -25.347985,
  "Pressure.allowed.Percentage" = -22.982644,
  "Hurries.Allowed" = -19.517631,
  "Beaten.by.Defender" = -17.454432,
  "Hits.Allowed" = -12.965955,
  "Penalties.Committed" = -9.781874,
  "Sacks.Allowed" = -9.203753,
  "Penalties.Declined" = -4.481739,
  "Recovered.Fumbles" = -4.103120
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        # For negative weights, lower raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        # For positive weights, higher raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}
```

```{r}
  "Hits.Allowed" = -12.965955,
  "Penalties.Committed" = -9.781874,
  "Sacks.Allowed" = -9.203753,
  "Penalties.Declined" = -4.481739,
  "Recovered.Fumbles" = -4.103120
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        # For negative weights, lower raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        # For positive weights, higher raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to Guard dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(g5_og_week9_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(g5_og_week9_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
og_input_all <- g5_og_week9_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
og_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(og_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(og_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  og_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View ---
important_features <- names(feature_weights)

og_full_view <- og_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    any_of(important_features)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
og_eval_summary <- og_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== G5 GUARD WEEK 9 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(og_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(og_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 GUARDS ===\n")
print(head(og_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(og_eval_summary)
View(og_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats
write.csv(
  og_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 9/G5/G5 Guard Full Stats Week 9.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet
write.csv(
  og_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 9/G5/G5 Guard Week 9 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. G5 Guard Full Stats Week 9.csv\n")
cat("2. G5 Guard Week 9 Grade 2024.csv\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total Guards evaluated:", nrow(og_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---
grade_dist <- og_eval_summary %>%
  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(og_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
# First filter for P4 Guards with at least 30 snaps (use Offensive.Snaps column)
p4_og_week11_2024 <- ol_week11_2024 %>%
  filter(Conference.Level == "P4", 
         Position == "G", 
         Offensive.Snaps > 30)

cat("Number of Guards after filtering:", nrow(p4_og_week11_2024), "\n")
glimpse(p4_og_week11_2024)

# --- Add Offensive Snaps from Summary (if needed) ---
og_summary_snaps <- offensive_summary_week11_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "G") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive.Snaps)

# Join snaps to Guard data (if needed)
p4_og_week11_2024 <- p4_og_week11_2024 %>%
  left_join(og_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# Handle any duplicate Offensive.Snaps columns
if ("Offensive.Snaps.x" %in% colnames(p4_og_week11_2024)) {
  p4_og_week11_2024 <- p4_og_week11_2024 %>%
    mutate(Offensive.Snaps = coalesce(Offensive.Snaps.x, Offensive.Snaps.y)) %>%
    select(-Offensive.Snaps.x, -Offensive.Snaps.y)
}

# --- Guard Weighted Grading Model ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (P4 Guard Model) ---
# Note: Negative weights for stats where lower numbers are better
feature_weights <- c(
  # Positive weights (higher is better)
  "Runblock.Grade" = 33.537126,
  "Percentage.of.Positive.Grade" = 27.989304,
  "Passblock.Grade" = 25.026261,
  "Defeated.Runblock.Percentage" = 22.413107,
  "Knockdown.Percentage" = 18.139550,
  "Games.Started" = 17.401159,
  "Pass.Block.Efficiency" = 15.300389,
  "Games.Played" = 11.868095,
  
  # Negative weights (lower is better)
  "Pressure.allowed.Percentage" = -20.877615,
  "Hurries.Allowed" = -14.531557,
  "Beaten.by.Defender" = -14.379106,
  "Hits.Allowed" = -10.078866,
  "Penalties.Committed" = -8.928237,
  "Sacks.Allowed" = -7.048949,
  "Recovered.Fumbles" = -4.220199,
  "Penalties.Declined" = -2.765358
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        # For negative weights, lower raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        # For positive weights, higher raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to Guard dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(p4_og_week11_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(p4_og_week11_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
og_input_all <- p4_og_week11_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
og_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(og_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(og_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  og_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View ---
important_features <- names(feature_weights)

og_full_view <- og_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    any_of(important_features)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
og_eval_summary <- og_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== P4 GUARD WEEK 11 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(og_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(og_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 GUARDS ===\n")
print(head(og_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(og_eval_summary)
View(og_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats
write.csv(
  og_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 11/P4/P4 Guard Full Stats Week 11.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet
write.csv(
  og_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 11/P4/P4 Guard Week 11 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. P4 Guard Full Stats Week 11.csv\n")
cat("2. P4 Guard Week 11 Grade 2024.csv\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total Guards evaluated:", nrow(og_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---
grade_dist <- og_eval_summary %>%
  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(og_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
# --- G5 Week 12 Guard Grading ---

# Correct way to change underscores to dots
colnames(ol_week12_2024) <- gsub("_", ".", colnames(ol_week12_2024))
colnames(offensive_summary_week12_2024) <- gsub("_", ".", colnames(offensive_summary_week12_2024))

# Verify the changes
colnames(ol_week12_2024)

# First filter for G5 Guards with at least 30 snaps (use Offensive.Snaps column)
# Also remove NOTRE DAME, UMASS, UCONN, ARMY, NAVY, AIR FORCE
g5_og_week12_2024 <- ol_week12_2024 %>%
  filter(Conference.Level == "G5", 
         Position == "G", 
         Offensive.Snaps > 30,
         !Team %in% c("NOTRE DAME", "UMASS", "UCONN", "ARMY", "NAVY", "AIR FORCE"))

cat("Number of Guards after filtering:", nrow(g5_og_week12_2024), "\n")
glimpse(g5_og_week12_2024)

# --- Add Offensive Snaps from Summary (if needed) ---
og_summary_snaps <- offensive_summary_week12_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "G") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive.Snaps)

# Join snaps to Guard data (if needed)
g5_og_week12_2024 <- g5_og_week12_2024 %>%
  left_join(og_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# Handle any duplicate Offensive.Snaps columns
if ("Offensive.Snaps.x" %in% colnames(g5_og_week12_2024)) {
  g5_og_week12_2024 <- g5_og_week12_2024 %>%
    mutate(Offensive.Snaps = coalesce(Offensive.Snaps.x, Offensive.Snaps.y)) %>%
    select(-Offensive.Snaps.x, -Offensive.Snaps.y)
}

# --- Guard Weighted Grading Model ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (G5 Guard Model) ---
# Note: Negative weights for stats where lower numbers are better
feature_weights <- c(
  # Positive weights (higher is better)
  "Runblock.Grade" = 35.700175,
  "Passblock.Grade" = 29.819727,
  "Percentage.of.Positive.Grade" = 29.647398,
  "Knockdown.Percentage" = 26.324587,
  "Games.Played" = 21.093918,
  "Pass.Block.Efficiency" = 13.252965,
  
  # Negative weights (lower is better)
  "Percentage.of.Negative.Grade" = -25.347985,
  "Pressure.allowed.Percentage" = -22.982644,
  "Hurries.Allowed" = -19.517631,
  "Beaten.by.Defender" = -17.454432,
  "Hits.Allowed" = -12.965955,
  "Penalties.Committed" = -9.781874,
  "Sacks.Allowed" = -9.203753,
  "Penalties.Declined" = -4.481739,
  "Recovered.Fumbles" = -4.103120
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        # For negative weights, lower raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        # For positive weights, higher raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to Guard dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(g5_og_week12_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(g5_og_week12_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
og_input_all <- g5_og_week12_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
og_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(og_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(og_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  og_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View ---
important_features <- names(feature_weights)

og_full_view <- og_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    any_of(important_features)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
og_eval_summary <- og_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---

cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(og_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
```

```{r}
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
og_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(og_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(og_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(og_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  og_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
og_input_all <- og_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View ---
important_features <- names(feature_weights)

og_full_view <- og_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    any_of(important_features)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
og_eval_summary <- og_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== G5 GUARD WEEK 13 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(og_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(og_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 GUARDS ===\n")
print(head(og_eval_summary, 10))

View(og_eval_summary)
View(og_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats

  og_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 13/G5/G5 Guard Full Stats Week 13.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 13/G5/G5 Guard Week 13 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE

cat("Highest Score:", max(og_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
```

```{r}
    mutate(Offensive.Snaps = coalesce(Offensive.Snaps.x, Offensive.Snaps.y)) %>%
    select(-Offensive.Snaps.x, -Offensive.Snaps.y)
}

# --- Guard Weighted Grading Model ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (P4 Guard Model) ---
# Note: Negative weights for stats where lower numbers are better
feature_weights <- c(
  # Positive weights (higher is better)
  "Runblock.Grade" = 33.537126,
  "Percentage.of.Positive.Grade" = 27.989304,
  "Passblock.Grade" = 25.026261,
  "Defeated.Runblock.Percentage" = 22.413107,
  "Knockdown.Percentage" = 18.139550,
  "Games.Started" = 17.401159,
  "Pass.Block.Efficiency" = 15.300389,
  "Games.Played" = 11.868095,
  
  # Negative weights (lower is better)
  "Pressure.allowed.Percentage" = -20.877615,
  "Hurries.Allowed" = -14.531557,
  "Beaten.by.Defender" = -14.379106,
  "Hits.Allowed" = -10.078866,
  "Penalties.Committed" = -8.928237,
  "Sacks.Allowed" = -7.048949,
  "Recovered.Fumbles" = -4.220199,
  "Penalties.Declined" = -2.765358
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        # For negative weights, lower raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        # For positive weights, higher raw values = higher normalized scores
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to Guard dataset ---
```
